title: Job Description: Senior AI / NLP Research Engineer (RAG Systems)

metadata.work_location: Ho Chi Minh City

content:
ORGANIZATION: COGNITIVE HR SOLUTIONS
OPEN POSITION: SENIOR AI & NLP RESEARCH ENGINEER (LOCAL RAG PIPELINES)

ABOUT US:
Cognitive HR is building next-generation intelligent recruitment and talent analytics software. We focus on on-premise, privacy-preserving enterprise AI systems.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Architect, build, and benchmark end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for HR document understanding (CV parsing, job-matching, competency gap detection).
- Research and implement advanced semantic chunking methods and document segmentation algorithms that outperform standard fixed-window approaches.
- Evaluate and fine-tune multilingual embedding models (e.g. Qwen, BGE, PhoBERT) to achieve state-of-the-art retrieval accuracy across Vietnamese and English corpora.
- Optimize local model inference and GPU memory allocation (RTX/Tesla series) via vLLM, Ollama, and INT4/INT8 quantization.
- Build evaluation benchmarks measuring Recall@K, MRR, and latency trade-offs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- 3+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning and Deep Learning with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Deep understanding of Vector Databases (PostgreSQL with pgvector, Chroma, Qdrant) and similarity search metrics.
- Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom semantic splitter implementations.
- Strong proficiency in Python, FastAPI, Docker, and Linux environments.
- Good knowledge of NLP concepts: tokenization, attention mechanisms, cross-encoders, and reciprocal rank fusion.

PERKS & ADVANTAGES:
- Attractive compensation package: $2,500 - $3,500 net per month.
- High-performance on-premise GPU workstations provided for research.
- Annual educational budget of $1,000 for AI conferences, certifications, and courses.
- Flexible working hours and 18 days of paid annual leave.

GIỚI THIỆU CHƯƠNG TRÌNH:
DEKON là công ty công nghệ có chi nhánh tại Melbourne (Australia) chuyên về các giải pháp Data, Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI), Web và Blockchain phức tạp. Chúng tôi mở chương trình đào tạo thực tập sinh bài bản nhằm xây dựng đội ngũ kỹ sư kế thừa chất lượng cao.

- Tham gia khóa huấn luyện chuyên sâu trong vòng 8 tuần theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế.
- Được hướng dẫn trực tiếp bởi các Technical Lead, Solution Architect nhiều năm kinh nghiệm tại Australia và Việt Nam.
- Thực hành quy trình phát triển phần mềm chuẩn Agile/Scrum, sử dụng các công cụ chuyên nghiệp: Jira, Confluence, Git, Teamwork.
- Trực tiếp tham gia phát triển tính năng, viết unit test và fix bug trong các dự án thực tế về AI, Big Data, Blockchain và Backend.
- Làm bài tốt nghiệp cuối khóa để đánh giá năng lực và cơ hội chuyển tiếp thành nhân viên chính thức (Junior Developer).

YÊU CẦU ỨNG VIÊN:
- Sinh viên năm cuối hoặc mới tốt nghiệp chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Kỹ thuật phần mềm.
- Điểm trung bình tích lũy (GPA) đạt từ 7.0/10 trở lên.
- Tư duy logic tốt, nắm vững kiến thức lập trình hướng đối tượng (OOP), cấu trúc dữ liệu và giải thuật.
- Thành thạo ít nhất một ngôn ngữ lập trình cơ bản: C, C++, Java, C#, hoặc JavaScript / Python.
- Có hiểu biết nền tảng về lập trình Web (HTML/CSS) và hệ quản trị cơ sở dữ liệu (SQL).
- Tiếng Anh đọc hiểu tốt tài liệu chuyên ngành; ứng viên giao tiếp tiếng Anh tốt có lợi thế làm việc trực tiếp với khách hàng quốc tế.

QUYỀN LỢI & ĐÃI NGỘ:
- Phụ cấp thực tập: 1,000,000 VNĐ / tháng + Thưởng KPI dự án.
- Tài trợ tối thiểu 70% chi phí các khóa học chứng chỉ công nghệ.
- Cơ hội ký hợp đồng lao động chính thức ngay sau khi kết thúc kỳ thực tập.
- Tham gia đầy đủ các hoạt động văn hóa: Team building, Happy Hour thứ 6 hàng tuần, CLB thể thao (Tennis, Pickleball).

title: Job Description: Remote Game QA Engineer (Mobile Games & Fun Factor) - XOAI

metadata.work_location: Fully Remote (Ha Noi / Ho Chi Minh City / Anywhere in Vietnam)

content:
COMPANY: XOAI GAMES
ROLE: GAME QA ENGINEER (REMOTE - MOBILE GAMES & GAMEPLAY TESTING)
LOCATION: 100% Remote (Ha Noi / Ho Chi Minh City)

MISSION:
We are seeking a QA Engineer who goes beyond bug catching. You will play a vital role in shaping mobile game prototypes from day one, playtesting early playable builds, evaluating the emotional "fun factor", and providing actionable feedback on game feel, controls, and difficulty curves.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Formulate, execute, and maintain test cases, test checklists, and test plans for early game prototypes.
- Conduct daily playtesting of early builds and provide critical evaluations of game responsiveness, tactile feedback ("juiciness"), controls, and pacing.
- Evaluate prototype mechanics against global mobile gaming market trends to help the team decide which prototypes to scale.
- Leverage modern AI tools to generate, organize, and accelerate test case creation and regression testing.
- Report bugs with accurate repro steps, isolation logs, and video captures.
- Coordinate daily testing status and blockers with game developers, artists, and game designers.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS:
- Genuine passion for mobile gaming and intuitive understanding of player psychology.
- Strong eye for "game feel", animation polish, tactile feedback, and control responsiveness.
- Comfortable testing unpolished, rough prototypes and prioritizing core gameplay viability over superficial glitches.
- Experience in bug tracking tools, test case management, and clear technical bug documentation.
- Proficiency in utilizing AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to enhance test coverage and speed up QA workflows.
- Critical thinking, attention to detail, and excellent written English communication.

PERKS:
- 100% remote working environment: zero commute, flexible work hours.
- Equal-opportunity, creative, and agile studio culture.
- Direct exposure to game industry veterans and rapid prototype iteration.

title: Job Description: Senior Information Security / Cyber Security Engineer - Techcom Securities

content:
COMPANY: TECHCOM SECURITIES (TCBS)
POSITION: SENIOR INFORMATION SECURITY / CYBER SECURITY ENGINEER
LOCATION: Techcombank Tower, 119 Tran Duy Hung, Cau Giay, Ha Noi

ABOUT US:
TCBS is the leading digital wealth and securities trading platform in Vietnam, processing billions of dollars in equities and bond transactions. Security and financial regulatory compliance are at the foundation of our engineering excellence.

ROLE MISSION:
Protect our financial cloud infrastructure, trading APIs, and proprietary wealth algorithms against advanced persistent threats (APT), fraudulent transactions, and unauthorized access.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Monitor, analyze, and investigate security events from hybrid cloud infrastructure using enterprise SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic Security).
- Formulate, tune, and maintain correlation rules and threat hunting queries mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.
- Conduct regular vulnerability scans across cloud workloads and lead remediation sprints with software engineering teams.
- Lead incident response procedures for Tier 2/3 security incidents, perform memory and network forensics, and formulate post-mortem RCA reports.
- Ensure technical compliance with State Bank of Vietnam regulations, ISO/IEC 27001, and PCI-DSS Level 1 standards.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- At least 3 years of hands-on experience in information security, SOC analysis, or DevSecOps.
- Proven expertise in enterprise SIEM administration (Splunk preferred), writing complex SPL queries and dashboard alerts.
- Solid understanding of network protocols, packet capture analysis (Wireshark/Zeek), and web application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).
- Proficient in scripting (Python, Bash) to automate incident investigation and threat intelligence ingestion.
- Professional certifications (CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, or AWS Security Specialty) are strongly advantageous.

BENEFITS & CULTURE:
- High-impact fintech environment with top-tier compensation packages.
- 13th month guaranteed salary + attractive performance-based equity bonuses.
- Premium health and dental insurance for employee and immediate family.

title: Job Description: Senior Data Lakehouse Engineer (Spark / Airflow / Snowflake) - DataForge Systems

content:

LOCATION: Etown Central, 11 Doan Van Bo, Ward 13, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City

DataForge Systems designs and deploys next-generation data lakehouses for Fortune 500 financial and logistics enterprises. We process petabytes of real-time event logs, sensor telemetry, and transactional ledgers.

WHY DATAFORGE:

content:
